title: Local reranking with Qwen3-Reranker through Ollama
description: Ollama has no rerank endpoint. Score candidates with Qwen3-Reranker through /api/generate raw prompts and next-token log probabilities (P(yes) versus P(no)), served by the existing Ollama. Ships only if the Phase 0 probe shows correct relevance ordering and acceptable latency; otherwise this issue is deferred and retrieval uses fusion only.
acceptance_criteria: Given probe pairs, when reranking, then relevant passages score above irrelevant ones.
Given the reranker is unavailable or disabled, when a question is asked, then retrieval completes with fusion ranking and the trace says reranking was skipped.
Given 30 candidates, when reranking on the reference machine, then latency stays within the budget recorded from Phase 0.
test_cases: Probe-pair ordering test against fixtures; skip/fallback path; latency evidence from Phase 0 and live verification.
verification: Deferred on 2026-10-09 after the Phase 0 S1 probe, per the user's rule (defer if not feasible through Ollama). Ollama 0.40.1-ara.2 returns logprobs from raw /api/generate, so the method works. However, the community dengcao/Qwen3-Reranker-0.6B:Q8_0 artifact produced uniform logits (also on stock 0.40.1). The 0.6B F16 tag ranked 12/12 probe triples correctly but took 54 s for 30 candidates (1.77 s per call, 4 CPUs). The 4B Q4_K_M took 180 s, and NUM_PARALLEL=4 gave no gain. That latency is not interactive on the reference CPU. RetrievalSettings.reranker_enabled now defaults to false, the UI hides the control, and retrieval uses reciprocal rank fusion. Revisit on GPU hosts or with a faster runtime.
